title: Relaxing Simulator
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#777, 2026-10-29), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal, rated 4 of 5 after 6 minutes: it defaults to ultra settings (8 fps on an M1), low settings with medium textures give 24 fps, some places such as the old ruins show artifacts on the castle, and a DualSense was not recognized, the Epic copy. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on an M1 with D3DMetal once the graphics are lowered (Epic).

knownIssues.symptom: Defaults to ultra settings, 8 fps on an M1
knownIssues.fix: set graphics to low with medium textures, about 24 fps

knownIssues.symptom: Graphical artifacts on the castle in the old ruins
DualSense controller not recognized by the game (an Xbox style XInput pad works)
knownIssues.fix: use an XInput pad, or start the game through Steam with Steam Input on (a non-Steam shortcut in the environment's Steam), as the reporter found with Breathedge
